Among 2020-2024 papers containing "quetiapine" , 32.5% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a much higher rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown for reference); relative to other words, papers with "quetiapine" are in the top 93rd percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better). Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
